title: Engine identity
description: Identifies one engine artifact: the public source commit it was built from and the API version host apps must match.

public_commit_sha.description: Commit of the public source tree the artifact was built from.

state_schema_version.description: Optional. The state database version the engine stamps on the data it writes. Absent in identities from before the field existed; a reader that does not know it must ignore it.

state_schema_min_readable.description: Optional, only with state_schema_version. The oldest state database version the engine can still read (never above state_schema_version; the written version when absent). A state database stamped outside the range is refused before anything is written.

channel.description: Release channel the artifact is built for; one artifact per channel.

kind.description: release: built for distribution (channel stable or beta). dev: a development engine (channel dev) that release and production build paths must refuse; it is always exactly the dev channel.

build_config_digest.description: SHA-256 of the build configuration (features, targets, toolchain).

bundle_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bundle's SHA256SUMS file, which lists every bundle file except SHA256SUMS and engine-identity.json.

slices.description: Optional. SHA-256 of each static library slice of an iOS bundle, by target triple: the device library and the simulator library a host app links. Present exactly when the bundle's layout has slices; every digest is also listed in the bundle's SHA256SUMS.

source.description: Where the bundle is published: a zip asset on a GitHub Release. Required in a consumer's engine.lock; optional inside the bundle's own identity file.

repository.description: GitHub owner/name that hosts the release.

release_tag.description: Release tag the asset is attached to.

asset_name.description: File name of the zip bundle asset.
